Hi all --

Thanks for the context. Below are the current, accurate statements we can provide today and the options we typically offer for enterprise deals. Happy to jump on a call to walk through.

SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report. We typically provide a redacted copy to prospects under NDA and can provide the full report via secure portal to authorized recipients. (Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf)

HIPAA / BAA: We can execute a BAA but only for Dedicated or Private deployments where customers control the environment and key management can be scoped accordingly. Hosted API does not support PHI/BAA in our standard offering. We will need to confirm the Amaya workload maps to Dedicated/Private to proceed.

Data deletion / retention specifics (standard / negotiable):
- Primary data (customer content): default contractual language: customer can request deletion; logical deletion occurs within 24 hours; physical removal from primary storage within 30 days. We can commit to a 30-day deletion SLA in contract language.
- Backups: backups are created for disaster recovery; our standard purge cycle is 90 days. Backups are immutable and stored on a regular rotation; therefore, deletion from backups is performed as part of our scheduled purge cycle. For enterprise customers we can extend the backup retention window to 180 days on request and reflect that in the contract. Note: even with an extended backup retention, we can add accelerated purge options as an add-on but that requires operational coordination and may affect pricing.
- Logs / telemetry: default retention 180 days. For customers requiring longer retention (e.g., 365 days) we can provide options: 1) extend retention in logging system (enterprise add-on) or 2) deliver logs to the customer's own cloud storage via export (preferred for long-term audit storage).

GDPR / DSARs: We process data subject requests per GDPR timelines. Deletion requests are propagated to backups as part of the scheduled purge; for audit/compliance we note the difference between logical deletion (immediate) and physical erasure from immutable backups (on purge cycle). We can include clarifying language in the DPA.

Suggested contract language snippets we recommend using (examples we can drop into the SOW/DPA):
- "Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to logically delete customer content upon request within 24 hours and to remove such content from primary storage within 30 days."
- "Backups are retained for a default period of 90 days; extended backup retention (up to 180 days) is available by agreement and will be reflected in the SOW."
- "Logs are retained for 180 days by default; alternate retention windows may be agreed in the SOW."

Next steps:
1) Liam/procurement: confirm whether Amaya prefers the 90-day backup default or needs 180 days so we can price/encode in SOW.
2) If PHI flows are confirmed, we should move this opportunity to Dedicated/Private and I can start the BAA conversation with legal.
3) I'll upload the redacted SOC 2 summary to a secure link once NDA is in place; please share the recipient list for access.

Happy to join a call next week with Amaya security/procurement to finalize wording.

Best,
